question: Lately we've seen many swords in their human forms, but I want to see Luffy's straw hat in human form as well! I hope you can deliver!
answer: Alright. a new request. This time we will do something that we have not done before. But well, as you all already know, anthropomorphization is my speciality. I even reproduced the scars Buggy left on it!→
name: Akimasa
